plan.title: Convert concluded RFQ to auction with starting quotations

steps.note: Create the RFQ that will provide the quotation used for conversion.
Every successful create flow requires a title.
Use an RFQ-only event as the source for conversion.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add a quoted product to the RFQ.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Add a vendor who can submit the source quotation.
Publish the source RFQ.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Submit the vendor quotation that should be carried into the auction.
Confirm the vendor quotation was accepted.
Conclude the RFQ so conversion starts from a closed event.
Open the conversion flow and continue to the converted auction setup screen.
Confirm conversion reached the auction setup without an application error.
Set and save the converted auction timing.
Publish the converted auction; this domain step handles the product's publish flow.
Confirm the converted auction is live.
Inspect the auction's enrolled participants.
Verify that the RFQ bidder is represented among the auction participants.
Open the auction comparison grid to inspect carried-forward bid data.
Verify the bidder appears as a real vendor column in Master QCS.
Verify the converted auction has a populated starting-rate cell for the RFQ bidder.
